assessments.reasoning: The hash-matched 17.0 vendor documentation names ISO/IEC 9075:2023 and describes departures in syntax or function alongside supported and unsupported features. This is direct evidence of the comparison and descriptive evidence for the dialect relationship.

challenge.method: I read the exact tagged appendix against the ISO title and Scope and challenged the alternative readings of full SQL:2023 conformance, ISO certification, and comparison with the Framework part alone. https://github.com/postgres/postgres/commit/d7ec59a63d745ba74fba0e280bbf85dc6d1caa3e https://www.iso.org/standard/76583.html
challenge.results: PostgreSQL explicitly compares its SQL behavior against the 2023 series and describes differences. The formal comparison references the whole series. The catalog relation classifies the dialect under the SQL language identity and points to Part 1 to identify that parent.

limitations: Dialect of SQL is a descriptive catalog classification supported by the appendix’s account of commonality and differences.
Coverage is vendor-described, release-specific and approximate. Certification, interchangeability and full conformance are outside scope.
